name: fmrl
description: Share anything your AI made: publish a page to fmrl.site and get a link. Adds /fmrl:share, /fmrl:whoami, /fmrl:attach and /fmrl:status and the fmrl_publish, fmrl_publish_file, fmrl_get, fmrl_edit, fmrl_set_visibility, fmrl_watch, fmrl_inbox, fmrl_list, fmrl_delete, fmrl_whoami, fmrl_attach, fmrl_status, fmrl_redeem and fmrl_rotate tools.
